After a visible attack against you resolves, use a Reaction to teleport up to 3 squares to a visible free supported square.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One visible willing ally within 3 squares immediately after an event applies temporary Frightened or Blinded.
Type
Magic / Recovery

Reduce the target's newly applied temporary Frightened and Blinded contributions by 2 each.
